sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，《纽约时报》播客。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: All right, we're going to break in with this Fox News alert here.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们现在插播一条福克斯新闻的突发报道。

sentences.en: We have just gotten word former President Donald Trump has been indicted.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚获悉，前总统唐纳德·特朗普已被起诉。

sentences.en: For the first time in U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国历史上，

sentences.en: history, a former president has been indicted on criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 前总统因刑事指控被起诉，这还是第一次。

sentences.en: This, of course, is unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 这当然是史无前例的。

sentences.en: The former president accused of paying $130,000 in hush money to Stormy Daniels in the weeks before the 2016 presidential election.
sentences.zh: 这位前总统被指控在2016年总统大选前的几周内，向斯托米·丹尼尔斯支付了13万美元的封口费。

sentences.en: My colleague, Ben Protess, on the case against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我的同事本·普罗特斯将为我们解读针对唐纳德·特朗普的这起案件。

sentences.en: And what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: I just hung up with the former president, and I asked, does he plan to turn himself in?
sentences.zh: 我刚刚挂断这位前总统的电话，我问他是否打算自首。

sentences.en: He said, you take care, John, and then he hung up on me.
sentences.zh: 他说，保重，约翰，然后就挂断了我的电话。

sentences.en: It's Friday, March 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月31日，星期五。

sentences.en: Ben, it is late.
sentences.zh: 本，现在很晚了。

sentences.en: It is after 9 p.m.
sentences.zh: 已经过晚上9点了。

sentences.en: It's been a very long day for you.
sentences.zh: 对你来说，这是漫长的一天。

sentences.en: I know you're tired.
sentences.zh: 我知道你累了。

sentences.en: Thank you for making time for us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: I want to begin, Ben, by just observing the enormity of what has just happened.
sentences.zh: 本，我想先谈谈刚刚发生这件事的重大意义。

sentences.en: Because for the past six years, we've lived through an endless cycle of investigations into Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为在过去的六年里，我们经历了一轮又一轮针对唐纳德·特朗普的无休止的调查。

sentences.en: Investigations into alleged campaign collusion with Russia, investigations into tax evasion,
sentences.zh: 对所谓竞选期间与俄罗斯勾结的调查，对逃税的调查，

sentences.en: January 6th, the mishandling of classified documents.
sentences.zh: 1月6日事件，以及对机密文件处理不当的调查。

sentences.en: All of those could have theoretically led to criminal charges, but so far haven't.
sentences.zh: 理论上，所有这些都可能导致刑事指控，但到目前为止都没有。

sentences.en: This time, in this investigation, it has.
sentences.zh: 这一次，在这项调查中，它发生了。

sentences.en: And it feels huge.
sentences.zh: 这感觉太重大了。

sentences.en: It is huge.
sentences.zh: 确实非常重大。

sentences.en: I mean, I think everybody uses the word unprecedented with this president.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为每个人在形容这位总统时都会用到“史无前例”这个词。

sentences.en: There have been so many unprecedented things.
sentences.zh: 发生了太多史无前例的事情。

sentences.en: But, you know, in our 250 years of this country, we've never had a president, sitting or former, who's been indicted.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，在我们国家250年的历史中，我们从未有过任何一位总统，无论是现任还是前任，遭到过起诉。

sentences.en: And the fact that we now have that is remarkable.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有了这样的情况，这确实非同寻常。

sentences.en: It is unexpected in many ways.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这都是出乎意料的。

sentences.en: Despite all the investigations you mentioned, he's always managed to escape.
sentences.zh: 尽管有你提到的所有调查，他总是能设法脱身。

sentences.en: And now we've sort of burst that bubble.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们某种程度上打破了这个泡沫。

sentences.en: And now that he's indicted, what is going to happen in the next few hours, the next few days?
sentences.zh: 既然他已经被起诉，接下来的几个小时和几天里会发生什么？

sentences.en: So we expect him to surrender to authorities in Manhattan early next week.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们预计他将于下周初在曼哈顿向当局自首。

sentences.en: Basically, what that means is that, like any felony defendant, he's going to be escorted into the bowels of the New York State courthouse in lower Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这意味着像任何重罪被告一样，他将被护送进入曼哈顿下城纽约州法院的内部深处。

sentences.en: And he's going to be fingerprinted.
sentences.zh: 他将被采集指纹。

sentences.en: He's going to be photographed.
sentences.zh: 他将被拍照。

sentences.en: And he's going to have to wait there until ultimately he's arraigned in a courtroom.
sentences.zh: 他将不得不一直在那里等待，直到最终在法庭上过堂。

sentences.en: Well, let's just spend a little bit of time with the indictment itself.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们花点时间来看看起诉书本身。

sentences.en: In the simplest terms, what exactly has Trump been charged with here?
sentences.zh: 用最简单的话来说，特朗普到底被控告了什么？

sentences.en: So the story I broke a few hours ago with my colleagues, including Willie Rashbaum and Jonah Bromwich, basically says that the grand jury has indicted Mr. Trump.
sentences.zh: 我几个小时前和我的同事威利·拉什鲍姆以及乔纳·布罗姆维奇共同爆料的新闻基本上指出，大陪审团已经起诉了特朗普先生。

sentences.en: But the indictment is going to remain under seal until he is arraigned in court.
sentences.zh: 但起诉书将一直处于保密状态，直到他在法庭上过堂。

sentences.en: So we don't get to know the specifics.
sentences.zh: 所以我们无法得知具体细节。

sentences.en: We don't get to know the charges.
sentences.zh: 我们无法得知具体的指控。

sentences.en: But what we do know from our reporting is that there are more than two dozen charges.
sentences.zh: 但从我们的报道中我们所知道的是，有两多打（二十多项）指控。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a huge number of charges.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个巨大的指控数量。

sentences.en: Yeah, and we also know that the Manhattan District Attorney, Alvin Bragg, has built a case that likely centers on the accusation that Mr. Trump falsified business records.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们还知道，曼哈顿地区检察官阿尔文·布拉格建立的案件可能围绕着特朗普先生伪造商业记录的指控展开。

sentences.en: These are business records from his company.
sentences.zh: 这些是他公司的商业记录。

sentences.en: And he did this a few years ago during the 2016 presidential campaign over a payment to a porn star, Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 他在几年前的2016年总统竞选期间，通过向色情明星斯托米·丹尼尔斯支付款项，实施了这一行为。

sentences.en: Right, a story we all know very well.
sentences.zh: 没错，这个故事我们都很熟悉。

sentences.en: In fact, a story we know probably a lot better than we wish we did.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这个故事我们了解的程度可能远超我们的愿望。

sentences.en: But just remind us of the very basic elements of that story.
sentences.zh: 但请提醒我们一下这个故事最基本的要素是什么。

sentences.en: Stormy Daniels and Trump.
sentences.zh: 斯托米·丹尼尔斯和特朗普。

sentences.en: So flashback to 2006.
sentences.zh: 那么，把时间拉回到2006年。

sentences.en: Donald and Stormy meet.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德和斯托米相遇。

sentences.en: According to Stormy, they have sex.
sentences.zh: 据斯托米说，他们发生了性关系。

sentences.en: And they keep in touch over the ensuing months.
sentences.zh: 并且在随后的几个月里他们保持着联系。

sentences.en: Fast forward to the 2016 presidential campaign about a decade later.
sentences.zh: 快进到大约十年后的2016年总统大选。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Trump and his people are suddenly afraid that Stormy is going to tell all and that her story is going to be hugely damaging, not just to his personal life.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和他的手下突然担心斯托米会把一切都抖落出来，她的故事将具有极大的杀伤力，不仅对他的个人生活——

sentences.en: You know, he was married at the time of the encounter with Ms. Daniels, but also to his campaign, which was already reeling from other accusations.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他和丹尼尔斯女士相遇时已经结婚了——而且对他的竞选活动也会造成打击，当时的竞选已经因其他指控而摇摇欲坠。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So basically, Michael Cohen, who was Mr. Trump's fixer at the time, comes up with $130,000 of his own money to buy her silence.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，当时担任特朗普先生私人律师兼密友的迈克尔·科恩自掏腰包拿出13万美元来买断她的沉默。

sentences.en: He pays the $130,000 in hush money to basically ensure that she's not going to tell her story.
sentences.zh: 他支付了13万美元的封口费，主要是为了确保她不会说出她的故事。

sentences.en: And she does indeed keep quiet about it.
sentences.zh: 而她也确实对此保持了沉默。

sentences.en: Trump, of course, wins the election, and everything seems like it's dead and buried.
sentences.zh: 特朗普当然赢得了大选，一切看起来都烟消云散、尘埃落定了。

sentences.en: Except that in 2018,
sentences.zh: 除了在2018年，

sentences.en: federal prosecutors in the Southern District of Manhattan figured this out after the Wall Street Journal published the story exposing the payoff to Ms. Daniels.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿联邦南区检察官在《华尔街日报》发表了一篇揭露向丹尼尔斯女士支付封口费的故事后，查明了这一点。

sentences.en: And the federal prosecutors and the FBI suddenly are now investigating Mr. Cohen, and they're upending his life.
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官和联邦调查局突然开始调查科恩先生，并彻底颠覆了他的生活。

sentences.en: And in the course of that, they drilled down on the $130,000 payment to Ms. Daniels.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，他们深入追查了向丹尼尔斯女士支付的13万美元款项。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And what they find out is that this payment was essentially an illegal campaign donation to the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 他们发现这笔支付本质上是对特朗普竞选团队的一笔非法竞选捐款。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is that when you're buying her silence, you're helping the campaign, right?
sentences.zh: 原因在于，当你花钱买她闭嘴时，你就是在帮竞选团队，对吧？

sentences.en: You're keeping out a damaging piece of information from voters' attention right before the election.
sentences.zh: 你是在大选前夕，阻止选民注意到一条具有破坏性的信息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that is an unrecorded and very excessive campaign donation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一笔未作记录且数额巨大的竞选捐款。

sentences.en: And Mr. Cohen pleads guilty.
sentences.zh: 科恩先生认罪了。

sentences.en: And in this very dramatic moment, stands up in court while he's pleading guilty and points the finger at the president and says,
sentences.zh: 并在那个非常戏剧性的时刻，他在法庭上认罪时站起来，把矛头指向总统并说：

sentences.en: I did this because I was directed to do it by Mr. Trump.
sentences.zh: 我这么做是因为特朗普先生指使我这么做的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what, remind us, becomes of that finger pointing by Cohen to the president of the United States?
sentences.zh: 请提醒我们，科恩将矛头指向美国总统这件事后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: So it's ultimately revealed that Trump reimbursed Cohen for the money, and Cohen goes on a publicity tour telling anyone who would listen, including Congress and the prosecutors,
sentences.zh: 最终查明，特朗普向科恩偿还了这笔钱，科恩随后开始了一场宣传巡演，向任何愿意听的人，包括国会和检察官，

sentences.en: that this was all orchestrated by Trump.
sentences.zh: 宣称这一切都是由特朗普一手策划的。

sentences.en: And that Trump knew that it was improperly covered up in internal documents at the company.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普知道这笔钱在公司的内部文件中被不正当地掩盖了。

sentences.en: But legally speaking, there's not much the prosecutors can do because there's a longstanding Justice Department policy that says you can't indict a sitting president.
sentences.zh: 但从法律上讲，检察官们无能为力，因为司法部有一项长期政策，即不能起诉在任总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So essentially, from the public view, that's where this hits a dead end.
sentences.zh: 所以从公众的角度来看，这基本上陷入了死胡同。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember that really well.
sentences.zh: 我对此印象非常深刻。

sentences.en: It kind of ends as a salacious curiosity involving the president that doesn't really seem to be going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 它最终变成了一个关于总统的风流八卦，似乎并没有什么实质性进展。

sentences.en: So walk us through how and why this case of all cases and this Manhattan district attorney of all prosecutors ends up reviving this case that seemed very dead because Trump was president and how we get to this indictment,
sentences.zh: 那么，请向我们解释一下，为什么偏偏是这个案件，以及这位曼哈顿地区检察官，最终让这个因特朗普曾是总统而看似彻底死掉的案件得以复活，以及我们是如何走到这份起诉这一步的，

sentences.en: the first and only criminal indictment of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是对唐纳德·特朗普的第一次也是唯一一次刑事起诉。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the feds closed the book on their case.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局对他们的案件合上了档案。

sentences.en: And just down the street is the Manhattan district attorney's office.
sentences.zh: 而隔壁街就是曼哈顿地区检察官办公室。

sentences.en: They opened their own investigation into the hush money.
sentences.zh: 他们对这笔封口费展开了自己的调查。

sentences.en: Originally, you had the DA, Cy Vance, who initially opened the investigation.
sentences.zh: 最初，时任地方检察官赛·万斯最初启动了这项调查。

sentences.en: In the course of that, he subpoenaed Trump's tax returns.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，他传唤了特朗普的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: They end up looking into a broader array of Trump's business practices.
sentences.zh: 他们最终开始调查特朗普更广泛的商业运作方式。

sentences.en: They looked into whether he lied on his financial statements.
sentences.zh: 他们调查他在财务报表上是否说谎。

sentences.en: And that was the case that everybody sort of thought they were going to bring.
sentences.zh: 这就是当时每个人都以为他们会提起的案件。

sentences.en: Not the hush money case, but the new DA, Alvin Bragg, he's sworn in early 2022.
sentences.zh: 不是封口费案，但新任地方检察官阿尔文·布拉格于2022年初宣誓就职。

sentences.en: And he inherits this case that was going to be focused on Donald Trump's business practices and whether he basically lied about his finances for years and years.
sentences.zh: 他接手了这个原本专注于唐纳德·特朗普的商业运作以及他多年来是否基本在财务上说谎的案件。

sentences.en: He looks at that case and he says, yeah, Trump, maybe he lied and falsified his financial records, but we just don't have it yet.
sentences.zh: 他查看了那个案件，然后说，好吧，特朗普可能确实撒谎并伪造了财务记录，但我们目前证据还不够。

sentences.en: We can't quite prove it.
sentences.zh: 我们还无法完全证明这一点。

sentences.en: And Bragg sort of decides, pump the brakes.
sentences.zh: 布拉格基本上决定踩刹车。

sentences.en: Well, the only problem was when he decided to pump the brakes, he got a tremendous amount of blowback.
sentences.zh: 好吧，唯一的问号在于，当他决定踩刹车时，遭到了巨大的反对。

sentences.en: And everybody was wanting to know, including in deep blue liberal Manhattan, why did you, Alvin Bragg, the DA we just elected, not want to indict Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 每个人都想知道，包括在深蓝色的自由派曼哈顿，为什么你这个我们刚选出来的地区检察官阿尔文·布拉格，不想起诉唐纳德·特朗普？

sentences.en: And in the course of the last few months, the zombie case comes back.
sentences.zh: 而在过去的几个月里，这个僵尸案件复活了。

sentences.en: This hush money case comes back from the dead once again.
sentences.zh: 这个封口费案再次从死里复活。

sentences.en: And sure enough, over the course of the last several months, they start examining new potential new theories and how to revive the case.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，在过去的几个月里，他们开始研究新的潜在新理论以及如何让案件复活。

sentences.en: And they impenal a grand jury in January.
sentences.zh: 他们在1月份召集了一个大陪审团。

sentences.en: And that's the same grand jury that just indicted him.
sentences.zh: 这就是刚刚起诉他的那个大陪审团。

sentences.en: And Ben, what made Bragg and made the lawyers in his office think that this zombie case was worth pursuing?
sentences.zh: 本，是什么让布拉格和他办公室的律师们认为这个僵尸案件值得继续追查？

sentences.en: What evidence did they have that made them want to try to bring these charges?
sentences.zh: 他们掌握了什么证据，让他们想要尝试提出这些指控？

sentences.en: They clearly feel that they have a deep body of evidence, and a lot of that hinges on Michael Cohen.
sentences.zh: 他们显然觉得他们掌握了大量的证据，其中很大一部分取决于迈克尔·科恩。

sentences.en: So Cohen has met with the district attorney's office 20 times.
sentences.zh: 因此，科恩已经与地区检察官办公室会面了20次。

sentences.en: He has testified before the grand jury twice for hours and hours.
sentences.zh: 他在大陪审团面前进行了长达数小时的两次作证。

sentences.en: And his story under oath is that Trump orchestrated this and was aware of all of the illegal aspects of the hush money deal.
sentences.zh: 他在宣誓下的证词是，特朗普策划了这一切，并且知晓封口费交易中所有非法环节。

sentences.en: And how does the evidence that they have accumulated bring them to charges?
sentences.zh: 他们积累的证据是如何让他们提出指控的？

sentences.en: I know we don't know the charges, but to the degree that you, based on your reporting, think you understand the charges.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们还不知道具体的指控，但根据你的报道，在你认为你理解的指控的范围内。

sentences.en: Help us understand how what Michael Cohen has been telling the district attorney might create these charges.
sentences.zh: 请帮助我们理解迈克尔·科恩一直在向地区检察官讲述的内容是如何可能构成这些指控的。

sentences.en: It all comes down to how Michael Cohen was reimbursed for the money he paid Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 这一切都归结为迈克尔·科恩是如何报销他支付给斯托米·丹尼尔斯的钱的。

sentences.en: So the hush money was paid by Cohen, but he was paid back by Trump.
sentences.zh: 封口费是由科恩支付的，但特朗普向他进行了偿还。

sentences.en: And Trump, while president, signed checks to Cohen, paying him back for all that money.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在担任总统期间，签署了支票给科恩，偿还了他垫付的所有钱。

sentences.en: And internally, in the Trump organization,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普集团内部，

sentences.en: they have these records that falsely say that the money had to do with legal expenses and that it had to do with a retainer agreement that Cohen had with them.
sentences.zh: 他们有这些虚假记录，上面写着这笔钱与法律费用有关，并与科恩和他们之间的一项常年法律顾问协议有关。

sentences.en: The problem was, of course, there was no retainer agreement.
sentences.zh: 当然，问题在于，根本没有什么法律顾问协议。

sentences.en: It was totally bogus.
sentences.zh: 这完全是伪造的。

sentences.en: There were no legal expenses, at least not in 2017 when he was repaid.
sentences.zh: 根本没有什么法律费用，至少在2017年他被偿还时没有。

sentences.en: This all had to do with hush money that Cohen had paid Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 这一切都与科恩支付给斯托米·丹尼尔斯的封口费有关。

sentences.en: And so if the whole thing was a work of fiction and if the whole thing was, according to Cohen, fraudulent,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果整件事都是虚构的，如果按照科恩的说法，整件事都是欺诈性的，

sentences.en: then that's what the district attorney is going to build his case around.
sentences.zh: 那么这将是地区检察官构建其案件的基础。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the alleged crime here, what is behind this indictment, we think, is the fraudulent claim of what this money was for.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里的所谓犯罪，也就是本起起诉书背后的核心，我们认为是关于这笔钱用途的欺诈性说辞。

sentences.en: It's, in actuality, paying off Daniels.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这是在给丹尼尔斯封口。

sentences.en: But Trump lies and says he's just paying his lawyer's fees.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普撒谎说他只是在支付律师费。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: And so the case could be built not just on Cohen's testimony,
sentences.zh: 因此，这个案件不仅可以建立在科恩的证词上，

sentences.en: but on the checks themselves that Trump signed and on the documents that show that the Trump organization improperly and falsely recorded for these payments as legal expenses,
sentences.zh: 还可以建立在特朗普亲笔签名的支票上，以及显示特朗普集团不当且虚假地将这些支付记录为法律费用的文件上，

sentences.en: which is just not true.
sentences.zh: 而这根本不是事实。

sentences.en: And so ultimately the case is very likely to come down to the falsification of those business records, which in the state of New York is a crime.
sentences.zh: 因此，最终该案很有可能归结为对这些商业记录的伪造，这在纽约州是一项刑事犯罪。

sentences.en: And it is a felony if you're using those false business records to commit or conceal a second crime.
sentences.zh: 如果你利用这些虚假的商业记录来实施或掩盖第二项犯罪，那么它就是重罪。

sentences.en: In this case, probably an election law violation.
sentences.zh: 在本案中，这很可能是违反选举法。

sentences.en: Okay, explain that.
sentences.zh: 好的，请解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: So they might be able to prove a crime of financial fraud from Trump lying about what this money was for allegedly.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们或许能够证明特朗普因涉嫌对这笔钱的用途说谎而犯下了金融欺诈罪。

sentences.en: What might be the second crime that would make this all a felony?
sentences.zh: 还有什么可能是让这一切变成重罪的第二项罪名呢？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So if the first crime is lying about what the money was for and these false business records,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果第一项罪名是隐瞒资金用途以及这些虚假商业记录，

sentences.en: the second crime very well could be that he was using those false business records to cover up a campaign finance crime.
sentences.zh: 那么第二项罪名很有可能就是他利用这些虚假的商业记录来掩盖一项竞选财务犯罪。

sentences.en: And in this case, that would be that Cohen paid money to Stormy Daniels to keep her quiet about a potential affair, an alleged affair.
sentences.zh: 在本案中，这就意味着科恩向斯托米·丹尼尔斯支付了封口费，让她对一段潜在的恋情、一段据称的恋情保持沉默。

sentences.en: And that that was essentially a huge contribution to Trump's campaign.
sentences.zh: 而这本质上是对特朗普竞选活动的一笔巨额捐款。

sentences.en: And the problem is that contribution was not recorded anywhere.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，这笔捐款根本没有在任何地方记录过。

sentences.en: And it was way in excess of what you're allowed to donate to a campaign.
sentences.zh: 而且它远远超过了法律允许向竞选活动捐款的上限。

sentences.en: And in New York state, there are campaign finance laws just like there are federally.
sentences.zh: 在纽约州，有竞选财务法律，联邦层面也是如此。

sentences.en: And if it ran afoul of those laws, that could be the second crime that the Trump organization and that Trump were essentially covering up.
sentences.zh: 如果它违反了这些法律，这就可能成为特朗普组织和特朗普本人实质上在掩盖的第二项罪名。

sentences.en: So the second crime involved here, which could be the one that makes that financial crime a felony, sounds familiar.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里涉及的第二项罪名——也就是可能使那项金融犯罪升级为重罪的罪名——听起来很耳熟。

sentences.en: And that is because it is the crime that Michael Cohen already pled guilty to.
sentences.zh: 这是因为，这就是迈克尔·科恩已经认罪的罪行。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Ben, important question.
sentences.zh: 所以，本，有个重要的问题。

sentences.en: How strong a case is this based on your reporting?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，这个案子的证据有多强？

sentences.en: I mean, I wouldn't call it a slam dunk,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不会称之为一个稳操胜券的案子，

sentences.en: but put yourself in the shoes of a juror in Manhattan who is evaluating a payment to a porn star that was covered up and lied about that potentially affected the outcome of the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 但如果你设身处地为曼哈顿的一名陪审员着想，他正在评估一项付款给色情明星、被掩盖且撒了谎、并可能影响2016年大选结果的交易。

sentences.en: Did I mention Manhattan, where people don't love the former president?
sentences.zh: 我提到曼哈顿了吗？那里的人们可不太喜欢这位前总统。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think that the prosecution feels pretty strongly that it has a provable case.
sentences.zh: 我认为检方坚信他们有一个证据确凿的案子。

sentences.en: That does not mean, however, that it does not have its challenges.
sentences.zh: 然而，这并不意味着它没有面临挑战。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个专注于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶唱片时代的光盘骑师夜总会里打碟时，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍爱的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你会把一个打碟台变成这样一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面陈列着美丽的有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Ben, right before the break, you said that the district attorney's office thinks it has a reasonably strong case, but that there are challenges that it faces in bringing it.
sentences.zh: 本，就在休息之前，你说过地区检察官办公室认为他们有一个相当有力的案子，但在提起诉讼时也面临着挑战。

sentences.en: So what are those challenges?
sentences.zh: 那么这些挑战是什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, so the first part of the case is not so hard.
sentences.zh: 对，所以案子的第一部分并不是那么难。

sentences.en: It's the bread and butter of the DA's office.
sentences.zh: 这是地方检察官办公室的看家本领。

sentences.en: They're bringing the accusation that Trump and his company essentially falsified business records.
sentences.zh: 他们提出的指控是，特朗普和他的公司本质上伪造了商业记录。

sentences.en: Nothing strange about that.
sentences.zh: 这没什么奇怪的。

sentences.en: But to make that case a felony, as we discussed, you have to have that second charge.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们所讨论的，要将该案定为重罪，你必须有第二项指控。

sentences.en: And that's a little bit trickier.
sentences.zh: 这就有点棘手了。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你什么意思？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: So if we're right, and the second crime is a campaign finance violation,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们没猜错，第二项罪名是违反竞选财务法，

sentences.en: then what's tricky here is that you have New York state prosecutors building a case in part around a violation of New York state election law,
sentences.zh: 那么这里棘手的地方在于，纽约州的检方在构建案情时，部分依据的是违反纽约州选举法的行为，

sentences.en: basically that this was an illegal campaign donation to the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是说这是一笔对特朗普竞选团队的非法竞选捐款。

sentences.en: But it was not a state campaign, right?
sentences.zh: 但这不是一场州级竞选，对吧？

sentences.en: It was a presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 这是一场总统竞选。

sentences.en: It was a federal campaign.
sentences.zh: 这是一场联邦竞选。

sentences.en: So you're having this unusual, potentially unprecedented mixing of New York state election law and a federal campaign.
sentences.zh: 所以你面临着这种不寻常的、可能前所未有的情况：将纽约州选举法与联邦竞选交织在一起。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's not as clean as most cases might be where it's state law, alleged state crime.
sentences.zh: 它不像大多数案件那样纯粹，那些案件通常只是州法律、涉嫌州犯罪。

sentences.en: This is a little bit funkier, you're saying.
sentences.zh: 你说得对，这有点古怪。

sentences.en: It's a little bit funkier.
sentences.zh: 确实有点古怪。

sentences.en: And as far as we can tell, this has never been tested.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这从未经过法律测试。

sentences.en: Because remember in the Michael Cohen case, that was entirely a federal case.
sentences.zh: 因为记住，在迈克尔·科恩的案子中，那完全是一起联邦案件。

sentences.en: Those were federal charges and dealing with a federal campaign.
sentences.zh: 那些都是联邦指控，处理的是联邦竞选。

sentences.en: Here, we're talking about state charges dealing with a federal campaign.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们谈论的是处理联邦竞选的州级指控。

sentences.en: And listen, when you're bringing criminal charges against the former president of the United States, who's now running once again,
sentences.zh: 听着，当你对一位正在再次参选的美国前总统提起刑事指控时，

sentences.en: it is challenging to bring a case that has never before been tested through the courts.
sentences.zh: 要推进一个从未在法庭上接受过考验的案件是极具挑战性的。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that they won't win.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着他们不会赢。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that there's not a lot of evidence suggesting that he will be convicted.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着没有大量证据表明他将被定罪。

sentences.en: It just means it's a challenge.
sentences.zh: 这只意味着这是一个挑战。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What should we make of the fact that this grand jury brought this indictment?
sentences.zh: 对于大陪审团提出这份起诉书这一事实，我们该作何解读？

sentences.en: I mean, does that tell us anything about the strength of the case?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这能说明案子有多硬吗？

sentences.en: Or is that a misreading of how important and clear a grand jury indictment actually is?
sentences.zh: 还是说这是对大陪审团起诉书的实际重要性和清晰度的一种误读？

sentences.en: Well, the adage is that a grand jury will indict a ham sandwich.
sentences.zh: 好吧，俗话说得好，大陪审团连火腿三明治都能起诉。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump, as many things, he's not a ham sandwich.
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德·特朗普，像很多事情一样，他可不是火腿三明治。

sentences.en: But this is still a lower bar, a lower threshold.
sentences.zh: 但这仍然是一个较低的标准，较低的门槛。

sentences.en: Basically, you needed a majority of the grand jurors to vote in favor of indicting him.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你只需要多数大陪审团成员投票赞成起诉他即可。

sentences.en: Whereas, obviously, you need a unanimous jury to convict him.
sentences.zh: 而在审判时，显而易见，你需要陪审团一致同意才能给他定罪。

sentences.en: And at trial, you're going to have to prove the case beyond a reasonable doubt.
sentences.zh: 并且在审判中，你必须毫无合理怀疑地证明案情。

sentences.en: And here it's a lower standard.
sentences.zh: 而这里的标准较低。

sentences.en: So you should not infer just from his indictment that he is going to be convicted.
sentences.zh: 所以你不应该仅仅根据他的起诉就推断他会被定罪。

sentences.en: But I do think what it does show is that they were able to convince a majority of these jurors that this case should be brought.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，这表明他们能够说服这些陪审员中的大多数人，认为这个案件应该被提起。

sentences.en: And certainly, they built a case that suggests that the president potentially committed these crimes.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们构建了一个表明总统可能犯下这些罪行的案件。

sentences.en: Ben, I think that a question on a lot of people's minds as they absorb this indictment and everything you have just said is, why did the Manhattan DA decide to bring this case?
sentences.zh: 本，我想在许多人消化这份起诉书以及你刚才所说的一切时，脑海中都会有一个问题：为什么曼哈顿地方检察官决定提起这个诉讼？

sentences.en: It's an old case.
sentences.zh: 这是一个老案子。

sentences.en: It involves this intimate, tawdry, personal story.
sentences.zh: 它涉及这个私密的、低级趣味的个人故事。

sentences.en: And from what you're saying, it's built on a pretty untested legal theory.
sentences.zh: 从你的讲述来看，它是建立在一个未经检验的法律理论之上的。

sentences.en: And it could fail.
sentences.zh: 而且它可能会失败。

sentences.en: So why this one?
sentences.zh: 那为什么偏偏是这个案子？

sentences.en: Well, in terms of whether or not to bring the case at all, I think that if the DA were asked this question, he would say that the rule of law applies to anyone.
sentences.zh: 好吧，就究竟要不要提起诉讼而言，我认为如果去问地方检察官这个问题，他会说法治适用于任何人。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter if you're the former president, you know, or someone off the street.
sentences.zh: 无论你是前总统，你知道的，还是街头路人，这都不重要。

sentences.en: It's that the law needs to be upheld.
sentences.zh: 重要的是法律必须得到维护。

sentences.en: And if they have the facts and the evidence to prove their case, that they should proceed.
sentences.zh: 如果他们有事实和证据来证明他们的案子，他们就应该继续推进。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But of course, the very nature of this case, Ben, is what invites Republicans to say that it's a witch hunt, right?
sentences.zh: 但是本，当然，这个案子的本质正是招致共和党人称之为政治迫害的原因，对吧？

sentences.en: Because it involves an affair, because it's old, because it comes from a Democratic district attorney who already experienced blowback for not bringing a different set of charges.
sentences.zh: 因为它涉及一段婚外情，因为年代久远，因为它出自一位民主党地方检察官之手，而这位检察官此前曾因没有对另一组指控提起诉讼而遭遇过反弹。

sentences.en: Bragg has to know that all of this is setting him up to seem to many Republicans like a partisan who's out to get Trump.
sentences.zh: 布拉格一定知道，这一切都在让他看起来像一个蓄意针对特朗普的党派人士，这会在许多共和党人眼中做实这一点。

sentences.en: Well, the Republicans are going to say that this is a witch hunt no matter what the case is.
sentences.zh: 好吧，无论案子是什么样的，共和党人都会说这是一场政治迫害。

sentences.en: And let's be honest, Bragg, the DA's case may not be the last case that we see against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 老实说，布拉格这位地方检察官的案子可能还不是我们针对唐纳德·特朗普看到的最后一个案子。

sentences.en: We may see future indictments of him unrelated to this in different jurisdictions.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会在不同的司法管辖区看到与此无关的针对他的未来起诉。

sentences.en: But all that's going to really matter is what people in the jury box think.
sentences.zh: 但真正重要的将是陪审席上的人们怎么想。

sentences.en: And they're the ones who ultimately decide his fate.
sentences.zh: 正是他们最终决定了他的命运。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, let's turn to the next phase of all of this, because as you already hinted at, the next few days, the next few weeks, they're going to be very strange.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们转向这一切的下一阶段，因为正如你已经暗示的那样，接下来的几天、接下来的几周将会非常奇特。

sentences.en: But the real drama, of course, is going to be this trial.
sentences.zh: 但真正的戏剧性，当然将是这场审判。

sentences.en: And assuming that Trump doesn't plead guilty and there's no reason to think he will, what would the timetable for that trial be?
sentences.zh: 假设特朗普不认罪——而且没有理由认为他会认罪——那么这场审判的时间表会是怎样的？

sentences.en: We have this potential extraordinary timetable.
sentences.zh: 我们迎来了这个潜在的非同寻常的时间表。

sentences.en: If we know one thing about Donald Trump's legal strategy, it's delay, delay, delay.
sentences.zh: 如果我们对唐纳德·特朗普的法律策略有所了解的话，那就是：拖延、拖延、再拖延。

sentences.en: And so I think that this could be likely delayed well into 2024.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为这很可能会被拖到2024年晚些时候。

sentences.en: We could be looking at a trial nine months, 12 months away.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的审判可能会在九个月、十二个月之后。

sentences.en: And, of course, that would raise this extraordinary prospect of having a trial unfolding against the backdrop of a presidential campaign,
sentences.zh: 当然，这将带来一种非同寻常的前景，即在总统竞选的背景下展开一场审判，

sentences.en: a campaign in which the defendant very well could be either the leading contender or even the nominee of his party.
sentences.zh: 在一场竞选中，被告很有可能成为其政党的领跑者甚至是提名人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And if Trump is found guilty in a trial, in the middle of a campaign, what kind of a sentence could he be looking at, potentially?
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普在竞选期间的一场审判中被判有罪，他可能会面临什么样的判决呢？

sentences.en: If a jury finds him guilty, it'll be entirely up to the judge to decide what to do.
sentences.zh: 如果陪审团判定他有罪，将完全由法官来决定如何处置。

sentences.en: The judge would not need to impose prison sentence, but he could face up to four years in prison.
sentences.zh: 法官不需要判处监禁，但他可能面临最高四年的监禁。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So it is possible that we could have a convicted former president headed for some prison sentence running for president in the middle of 2024.
sentences.zh: 所以完全有可能出现这样一种情况：一位被定罪的前总统正朝着某种监禁刑罚走去，同时还在参加2024年年中到来的总统大选。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But to be clear, you do not need to have a clean criminal record to be able to hold the office of the presidency.
sentences.zh: 但需要明确的是，你不需要拥有清白的犯罪记录就能担任总统职务。

sentences.en: In other words, Trump could be convicted and still be reelected.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，特朗普即使被定罪，依然可以再次当选。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Under the Constitution, that's the deal.
sentences.zh: 根据宪法，情况就是这样。

sentences.en: It's like unprecedented on top of unprecedented on top of unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 这就像是史无前例之上叠着史无前例，再叠着史无前例。

sentences.en: Everything about this case feels totally historic.
sentences.zh: 关于这个案件的一切都让人感觉完全具有历史意义。

sentences.en: And that's because it is.
sentences.zh: 那是因为它确实如此。

sentences.en: Well, Ben, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，本，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: In a statement released on Thursday night, Trump called the indictment, quote,
sentences.zh: 在周四晚间发表的一份声明中，特朗普将起诉书称作，引述原话，

sentences.en: political persecution and election interference at the highest level in history, called the Manhattan district attorney who brought the case against him a disgrace,
sentences.zh: “历史上最高级别的政治迫害和选举干预”，称将他起诉的曼哈顿地方检察官为耻辱，

sentences.en: and described himself as a completely innocent person.
sentences.zh: 并把自己描述为一个完全清白的人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Today is a tough and a tragic day for Kentucky, for the Fort Campbell, and for the 101St.
sentences.zh: 对于肯塔基州、坎贝尔堡基地以及第101空降师来说，今天是艰难而悲惨的一天。

sentences.en: Nine soldiers have died after the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美军

sentences.en: Army helicopters they were riding in collided during a training mission along the border of Tennessee and Kentucky,
sentences.zh: 陆军直升机在田纳西州和肯塔基州边境沿线执行训练任务时发生相撞，造成9名士兵死亡，

sentences.en: whose governor, whose governor, Andy Beshear, spoke about the accident on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州州长安迪·贝希尔周四就这起事故发表了讲话。

sentences.en: The crash, which occurred late Wednesday night, involved two Black Hawk assault helicopters that took off from Fort Campbell.
sentences.zh: 这起坠机事故发生在周三深夜，涉及两架从坎贝尔堡起飞的“黑鹰”突击直升机。

sentences.en: The cause of the collision is under investigation.
sentences.zh: 相撞原因正在调查中。

sentences.en: We are blessed to live in the freest country in the history of planet Earth.
sentences.zh: 我们有幸生活在地球历史上最自由的国家。

sentences.en: But we must remember that that freedom relies on those who are willing to serve, some of which pay the ultimate price.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须记住，这种自由依赖于那些愿意奉献的人，其中有些人付出了生命的最高代价。

sentences.en: And Russia has detained an American journalist for the Wall Street Journal,
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯扣留了一名《华尔街日报》的美国记者，

sentences.en: accusing him without providing any evidence of espionage in a major escalation of its wartime tactics against foreign media.
sentences.zh: 在针对外国媒体的战时战术重大升级中，在没有任何证据的情况下指控他从事间谍活动。

sentences.en: The reporter, Evan Gerskovich, who is based in Moscow, is believed to be the first American journalist held as an accused spy inside Russia since the collapse of the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 这名驻莫斯科的记者埃文·格什科维奇被认为自苏联解体以来，第一位在俄罗斯境内被当作间谍嫌疑人扣押的美国记者。

sentences.en: The Journal vehemently denied Russia's claims that Gerskovich is a spy and called for his immediate release.
sentences.zh: 《华尔街日报》强烈否认俄罗斯关于格什科维奇是间谍的说法，并呼吁立即释放他。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Jessica Chung and Alex Stern, with help from Carlos Prieto and Asta Chaturvedi.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由杰西卡·钟和亚历克斯·斯特恩制作，卡洛斯·普里耶托和阿斯塔·查图维迪提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester and Paige Cowett, contains original music by Diane Wong and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由雷切尔·奎斯特和佩奇·科维特剪辑，包含黛安·王和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德担任工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由来自Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.zh: 本周的《电线切割机秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 请收听有关如何让您的客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要黑暗环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方搜索“The Wirecutter Show”。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
